resources.string: Read on-screen text in every browser plus X, Facebook, Instagram, Reddit, TikTok, and YouTube. Nothing is uploaded.
Show a full-screen reminder the moment a match is found.
Keeps Guard running so the system does not put it to sleep.
Toggles open system settings. Android requires you to grant these yourself.

Interveen uses Android Accessibility so Guard can work on this device.

What Interveen will access:
On-screen text in browsers and in apps such as Chrome, X, Facebook, Instagram, Reddit, TikTok, and YouTube. This includes address-bar text and visible content.

How it is used:
Text is matched against a blocklist stored on this phone. If adult content is opened, Interveen closes that session and shows the personal reminder you chose.

What Interveen will not do:
This data never leaves the phone. It is not uploaded, not sold, and not used for advertising or analytics. Interveen does not control other apps except to close a matched session and show your overlay.

You can turn Interveen Guard off later in Android Settings → Accessibility.

Interveen needs “Display over other apps” so Guard can show your reminder on top of the browser or app that was just closed.

What Interveen will do:
When adult content is opened, Interveen presents a full-screen overlay with the video, image, or words you chose. The overlay stays on top until you dismiss it.

What Interveen will not do:
Interveen does not record your screen, does not draw over other apps at other times, and does not send anything off this phone. You can turn this off later in Android Settings → Display over other apps.
